record.title: Abkhaz de facto authorities close Shamgona–Tagiloni crossing
record.enforcement: Public Defender retrospectively dates closure to April 2016.
record.official_rationale: District head said consolidating checkpoints made control easier and more effective, while a repaired road improved access to the main Enguri checkpoint.
record.context: Pre-window closure remained in effect when Public Defender reviewed consolidation in 2017.
record.uncertainty: April 15 effective abolition is attributed to contemporaneous Radio Atinati reporting. November 2017 is last-confirmed status; no reopening or continuation to the research cutoff is assumed.
